Name: (SDR) - Mega Farm II
Author: klatuprism
Description:
A crazy large (200x200) expansion map for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10512]Stardew Realty[/url].

The land is divided by fences into sections for barns, growing and buildings.

The expansion is available at the start of Year 3 for 20,000 gold.

You can customize the availability by editing the expansion.json file.  The file is located in the this mods top directory.  Open the expansion.json file in your favouriite text editor and modify the "Requirements" entry.  Blanking it out will make the land available at the start of the game.  You can also change the cost of the land by modifying the "Cost" entry.

Downloads.Description: Stardew 1.6 edition.  Requires the latest Stardew Realty.
